fields.description: Nothing on this page works until a key is saved here. Two keys are used: one stays on the server, the other is sent to the browser and must be restricted.
fields.label: Google keys

fields.description: Used by the server only, to look up addresses and draw the small maps on task cards. While blank, addresses are not resolved and no map picture is drawn.
fields.label: Google Maps API Key (server)

fields.description: Used by the Near Me map only. It is sent to the browser, so it must be a separate key restricted to this site's domains. While blank, Near Me reports that the map is not configured.
fields.label: Google Maps Browser Key (Near Me)

fields.description: Needed by the clustered pins on the Near Me map. While blank, an unstyled demo map is drawn.
fields.label: Google Maps Map ID (Near Me)

fields.description: Looks up an address with the saved server key and shows the result, which proves the key and the billing account are live. Save the page first.
fields.label: Check Connection

fields.description: The settings for the clinic address search, used by the Desk picker and the Near Me search box.
fields.label: Address search

fields.description: Addresses are always resolved by Google. Shown for information; it cannot be changed.
fields.label: Geocoding Provider

fields.description: The two-letter country the address search is limited to, such as IN. While blank, the whole world is searched.
fields.label: Address Search Country

fields.description: The choice of who draws each map. Near Me is always a Google map, because it is interactive.
fields.label: Map display

fields.description: Draws the small map on task cards and in the activity list. Blank uses OpenStreetMap.
fields.label: Thumbnail Map Provider

fields.description: Draws the larger map inside the visit pop-ups. Blank uses Google.
fields.label: Dialog Map Provider

fields.description: The zoom level of the small map pictures. A higher number sits closer to the pin. Blank uses 16.
fields.label: Map Thumbnail Zoom

fields.description: Advanced. Where OpenStreetMap fetches its map tiles. Blank uses the free public tiles, which are rate-limited.
fields.label: OpenStreetMap Tile URL

fields.description: The leads whose visits are checked against a clinic, and the role allowed to correct a pin.
fields.label: Visit location tracking

fields.description: The lead groups whose in-person visits must be logged at the doctor's clinic, with the distance allowed. While empty, no visit is checked.
fields.label: Location-Tracked Grains

fields.description: The role allowed to move a clinic's pin once it is set. Blank allows System Manager only.
fields.label: Manager Override Role
